steps.text: Fire devours all indiscriminately.
One fire can destroy everything, no matter how precious, no matter how treasured.
Gerald once said the Sarkaz have no home, only war that follows them wherever they go. They swore fealty to their lord in the hope of finding a home of their own.
He left because he became disappointed.
I did not dare to ask why he was disappointed.
We were full of hope when we first came here.
We were happy despite the hardship.
But now...
Now, they are leaving. Is it because life here has disappointed him in the same way?
What about me?
I am watching the things I treasured burn before my eyes.
Burning.
Fading away.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Gone... all gone...

steps.name: Anxious Inhabitant
steps.text: Fire! Fire!

steps.name: Panicked Inhabitant
steps.text: The sacrarium is burning! Get water! Water!

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: What's going on? Is that a fire?

steps.name: Panicked Inhabitant
steps.text: Raimund! What are you doing here? I thought you had...

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Now's not the time for that!

steps.name: Panicked Inhabitant
steps.text: Y-You're right!

steps.name: Panicked Inhabitant
steps.text: The sacrarium's on fire! Give me a hand!

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: The sacrarium?!

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: How did the sacrarium catch fire?

steps.name: Panicked Inhabitant
steps.text: How should I know?! Fires have happened before, but nothing as bad as this one. And the timing!

steps.name: Panicked Inhabitant
steps.text: We need to put it out! Thank goodness it wasn't the residences...

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Keep fighting the fire. I'll get help.

steps.name: Anxious Inhabitant
steps.text: Water! *cough* More water!

steps.name: Calm Inhabitant
steps.text: The fire's too fierce!

steps.name: Calm Inhabitant
steps.text: Careful of the smoke! Close the door, that might keep the fire from spreading...

steps.name: Anxious Inhabitant
steps.text: What are you talking about?!

steps.name: Anxious Inhabitant
steps.text: It's the sacrarium! The holy statue is in there! Closing the door won't put the fire out!

steps.name: Calm Inhabitant
steps.text: That's not what I mean! But it's too dangerous right now!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: A wise decision.

steps.name: Anxious Inhabitant
steps.text: What do you know... who are you?

steps.name: Anxious Inhabitant
steps.text: Kids...? No, how could you bring children to a dangerous place like this?!

steps.name: Anxious Inhabitant
steps.text: Stay away! It's not safe here!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: You're right. It's not safe.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: You've inhaled a lot of smoke. Continue to do so, and you'll begin experiencing symptoms of smoke inhalation.

steps.name: Anxious Inhabitant
steps.text: So what? Got anything useful to say?

steps.name: Anxious Inhabitant
steps.text: I've never seen you before... you're Sankta, right? From Laterano? That's a holy statue of Laterano! Do something!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: My mission does not involve the statue.

steps.name: Anxious Inhabitant
steps.text: What are you talking about? Now's no time to talk about some 'mission'!

steps.name: Anxious Inhabitant
steps.text: Use your... your... your Arts to put that bloody fire out, or get out of the way if you're not gonna help!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I'm afraid I'm unable to use Arts suitable for that purpose.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: More people are needed to fight the fire and minimize damage.

steps.name: Anxious Inhabitant
steps.text: I'll get help!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: There's no need.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: They're coming.

steps.name: Anxious Inhabitant
steps.text: You're here...

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: We got word from Raimund.

steps.name: Hot-Headed Sarkaz
steps.text: Enough talk. Take the bucket! I'll go get more!

steps.name: Anxious Inhabitant
steps.text: A-Alright!

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: More here!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I've got it.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Find a safe place to wait.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: You're that Lateran...

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: And what of the kids?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I do not believe now is the right time to discuss that.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Here, bucket.

steps.name: Calm Inhabitant
steps.text: Clément!

steps.name: Calm Inhabitant
steps.text: Stop, Clément! Don't go any further!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I advise against going into the scene of the fire right now.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Let me go! Let me go!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: It is dangerous without proper protective equipment.

steps.name: Calm Inhabitant
steps.text: He's right!

steps.name: Calm Inhabitant
steps.text: Are you trying to get yourself killed?!

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: I have to—

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: I have to...

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Sorry... I lost my head.

steps.name: Calm Inhabitant
steps.text: I know it hurts, but this is serious.

steps.name: Calm Inhabitant
steps.text: Flowers can be replanted.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: We're running out of water. I'll fill a few more buckets.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: We can't go any further! The fire and smoke are too much...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: You can stay behind.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I suggest not speaking loudly to avoid smoke inhalation.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: And who's the reason I have to speak?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: You don't need to follow me.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: I don't trust you. I'm keeping an eye on you.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Wait, did you hear that?
The fire continues to burn, and the gun-wielding statue creaks ominously.
It casts a scorching shadow on Raimund, as though passing judgment on the Sarkaz who dared to set foot in a Sankta sacrarium, as it begins to topple in the fire.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Get back!
There is a sharp cracking sound, but the expected pain does not come.
The Executor stands before the Sarkaz, his gun held high.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: This way, before anything else falls!

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Your arm...

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: No, wait a second, you destroyed the statue?!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I did not destroy it, only changed its direction to prevent it from hitting you.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: But it's your statue...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: That does not matter.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: The fire continues to grow. It's atypical.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Although furnishings like wooden benches are flammable, the initial location of the fire was unusual. It's possible that something else caused the fire.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: What do you mean? What are you trying to say?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: That is...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: (Is this where the Sarkaz live?)

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: (The walls are too thin to guard against the winds blowing across the wastes.)

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: (It really is chilly.)

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: (It's getting dark. I'm taking too long.)

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: (Hm?)

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: (Is that a fire I see up there?)

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: (A fire, now?)

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: (Looks like there's trouble on Federico's side.)

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: (...! Someone's coming!)

steps.name: Concerned Sarkaz
steps.text: They've gone to help at the abbey. Should we go too?

steps.name: Concerned Sarkaz
steps.text: Stefano was good to us. Even if we're leaving...

steps.name: Angry Sarkaz
steps.text: You go if you want to, but keep me out of this!

steps.name: Angry Sarkaz
steps.text: They've got their Lateran friends! Let them help. We're not welcome there.

spans.text: They've got their Lateran friends! Let

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: (Well, guess I just got into the habit of hiding myself.)

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: (Was there an argument? Things weren't like this when Oren and I first came...)

steps.name: Concerned Sarkaz
steps.text: Don't be mad. Leyla didn't mean to say that...

steps.name: Angry Sarkaz
steps.text: She definitely thought it, even if she didn't mean to say it!

steps.name: Angry Sarkaz
steps.text: She said I stole her winter clothes! Me, a thief? Taking care of this stuff has been my responsibility for years!

steps.name: Concerned Sarkaz
steps.text: Man...

steps.name: Angry Sarkaz
steps.text: She thinks we're an eyesore! They all think so! They never treated us the same as them!

steps.name: Angry Sarkaz
steps.text: They hate us because Stefano refused to abandon us and return to Laterano! I see them for who they are now. We're the only ones who thought of us as family!

steps.name: Angry Sarkaz
steps.text: I hesitated when Gerald wanted to leave. Now, I realize he was right.

steps.name: Angry Sarkaz
steps.text: They want us gone? We'll be gone!

steps.name: Concerned Sarkaz
steps.text: Can we really get out of here, though? The scouts haven't come back...

steps.name: Angry Sarkaz
steps.text: Still better than waiting. Next time this happens, I won't be able to stop myself from punching someone.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: It's cold.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I spent so much time holed up in a room that I forgot how cold the night outside was.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Velliv is going to cut my pay for this.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I guess I'll make my own shining fruit dobosh for Mostima rather than buy it if that happens.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Time is running out...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: —Found you!

steps.name: Calm Inhabitant
steps.text: It's finally out...

steps.name: Calm Inhabitant
steps.text: Everything is gone, but at least the fire didn't spread below. It could've been worse.

steps.name: Panicked Inhabitant
steps.text: What do you mean, 'it could've been worse'?!

steps.name: Panicked Inhabitant
steps.text: Look at the statue! And the flowers... oh.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: No one was hurt. That's a good thing.

steps.name: Hot-Headed Sarkaz
steps.text: What about you, Raimund?

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Fine. Not dead yet.

steps.name: Hot-Headed Sarkaz
steps.text: You crazy kid, you really charged straight in!

steps.name: Hot-Headed Sarkaz
steps.text: Just you wait, Gerald will smack you around when he hears about this!

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Don't tell Gerald.

steps.name: Hot-Headed Sarkaz
steps.text: Ha, now you're scared.

steps.name: Anxious Inhabitant
steps.text: Where's the Abbot? Did anyone tell him?

steps.name: Calm Inhabitant
steps.text: Well, informing him is about all we can do right now.

steps.name: Calm Inhabitant
steps.text: Everybody be careful. We don't want any more accidents...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: It wasn't an accident.

steps.name: Estara & Erendel
steps.text: Federico!

steps.name: Calm Inhabitant
steps.text: What did you say?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: It wasn't an accident. I believe this was an act of arson.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: That's not something to say lightly, Lateran.

steps.name: Anxious Inhabitant
steps.text: Impossible... who would want to burn the sacrarium down?

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Do you have proof?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Like I said.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: The fire spread in an unusual way. It was caused by a foreign source.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: That's all?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Enough to reach a conclusion.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Why you—

steps.name: Panicked Inhabitant
steps.text: Wait a second, Raimund.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: What? You think this is arson too?

steps.name: Panicked Inhabitant
steps.text: I... I don't know. But...

steps.name: Panicked Inhabitant
steps.text: I went to look for help. People don't hang around this place much, especially you Sarkaz...

steps.name: Panicked Inhabitant
steps.text: But I bumped into you.

steps.name: Hot-Headed Sarkaz
steps.text: Hey, what are you getting at?!

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Don't interrupt, Fernand!

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Let him finish.

steps.name: Panicked Inhabitant
steps.text: I... I don't mean... I just wanted to ask...

steps.name: Panicked Inhabitant
steps.text: What were you doing there, Raimund?

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: Is this what you wanted to show me, Gerald?

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: People don't say what's really on their minds around us.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: This is our reality, Stefano.

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: I know. I've always known.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: No one is wrong. This isn't anyone's fault. We just want to live in peace. But this is how things are.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: The Sarkaz are doomed to wander.

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: I told you this place would be your home.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: You did.

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: You said you wanted the children to take root here.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Maybe I was wrong.

steps.name: Abbot
steps.text: You said no one is wrong.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: There's a lot on your mind lately, Stefano.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: What are you planning?

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Or, should I ask...? Did you have anything to do with this fire?
